name: Dr. Marc Halpern
reason: Health rule: his work is mainly clinical medical training. The California College of Ayurveda he founded and leads (ayurvedacollege.com, robots.txt allows us) trains practitioners in clinical Ayurvedic medicine: its programmes are the Clinical Ayurvedic Medicine Program, Clinical Ayurvedic Specialist ('assisting those who are sick'), Ayurvedic Health Practitioner interns 'supporting patients', panchakarma case management and a clinical nasya treatment workshop; he trained first as a chiropractor. His Shift course was 'Ayurveda for Strengthening Your Immune System'. A yoga-nidra class and an introductory course exist but sit inside a medical school.
